title: Federal Rule 15 — amendment and relation back
shortTitle: Federal Rule 15 — amendment and relation back
summary: Amendment changes a party’s pleading as the case develops. The rules distinguish changes allowed without permission from those requiring consent or leave of court, and address the effect on timing and trial.

sections.Role in the course: Amendment changes a party’s pleading as the case develops. The rules distinguish changes allowed without permission from those requiring consent or leave of court, and address the effect on timing and trial.
sections.What to examine: Identify the stage, the proposed change, delay, good faith, prejudice, and whether the amendment would be legally futile. Beeck considers withdrawal of an admission; Krupski concerns relation back after the limitations period.
